title: W10/W10b zero seed original evidence review

scope.package_integrity_owner: D independently checks all 13 deliveries; this review hashes only selected source/log/snapshot inputs.

conclusions.mathematical_statement: General q theorem requires actual non-sNaN. The actual separately rounded ExecFloat.mul result is proved non-sNaN for all raw inputs, yielding a premise-free product-seed identity at full carrier and raw-word levels.
conclusions.W10b_difference: Runtime implementation changes from choosing a full old carrier to choosing a UInt32 then ExecFloat.ofRaw. It is proved extensionally equal for all q, including raw NaNs. Final Proofs attempt1->2 only adds two NaN/sNaN preservation theorems.
conclusions.official_policy: W10b Core and Increment pass the fixed raw import/BANNED checks; their complete W10-based verification units inherit raw import-comment, #_ and attribute matches. The supplied PASS is not full official gate eligibility.
conclusions.minimal_integration: Feasible by replacing only singletonCore's initial add with a raw -0->+0 normalizer on the existing exact product, after porting proof dependencies and adding the Submission equality bridge. That new integration is NOT_RUN.

proof_review.add_zero_general_path: Split actual native isNaN. Non-NaN native branch proves +0 preserves every unpacked constructor except -0 and uses exact nonNaN carrier roundtrip. Quiet NaN branch unfolds the real Spec and uses quietNaN self preservation. The actual isSNaN=false premise is retained.
proof_review.mul_classification: Unfold actual Model.Spec.mul, covering both finite dyadics (signed zero or real rounder), selected NaN, invalid result and native overflow. Every branch ends in a concrete not-sNaN lemma. The actual ExecFloat.mul theorem is obtained via its real carrier/model refinement, not a model-only assumption.
proof_review.no_arbitrary_snan_shortcut: Raw normalizer intentionally preserves sNaN. The supplied negative witness q=0xff800011 has normalizer raw0xff800011 but real +0 addition raw0xffc00011.
proof_review.signed_zero: Raw -0 product becomes +0, including negative underflow and +0 * negative finite. +0 and every other raw word remain unchanged.
proof_review.invalid_payload: 0*Inf invalid canonical qNaN remains unchanged after multiplication; signaling inputs are first quieted by the existing actual multiply with exact original priority, sign and payload. The normalizer does not canonicalize those words.
proof_review.no_fusion: The theorem concerns separately rounded actual multiply then add. It is not FMA, reassociation or real-number equality.
